source:
Right, is everyone here? Let me just get the slides up. Okay. Sorry about last week, the projector was broken, so we're going to pick up where we left off. Before I start — the assignment deadline moved to the 14th, it's on the portal, please check the portal, I'm not answering emails about the portal.

So. Index numbers. Today's topic. Index numbers.

An index number is a statistic that expresses the value of a variable in one period as a proportion of its value in a reference period, which we call the base period. We multiply by one hundred so that the base period equals one hundred. That's the whole idea. The formula, and you will need this, is I sub t over zero equals Y sub t divided by Y sub zero, times one hundred. Y sub t is the value in the current period, Y sub zero is the value in the base period.

So if the base period equals one hundred, and you get a value of one hundred and twelve, that means the variable has grown by twelve percent relative to the base. If you get ninety-three, it's fallen by seven percent. This is simple but people get it wrong on the exam every single year, so please, one hundred is the base, the number you get is relative to the base.

Now. The distinction that actually matters. There are two families of index. Simple indices and composite indices. A simple index tracks one single variable — the price of bread, the output of one factory. A composite index aggregates several variables into one figure — the consumer price index, which tracks a basket of goods. Simple is one thing, composite is many things. Composite is where all the difficulty is, because the moment you aggregate, you have to decide how much each item counts. That's weighting.

Let me say that again because it's the crux of the whole course. When you aggregate, you must weight. Unweighted aggregation treats a kilo of salt as equally important as a monthly rent payment, which is obviously nonsense.

So, weighting. There are two canonical approaches and they differ in exactly one respect: which period's quantities you use as weights.

The Laspeyres index uses base-period quantities. You ask: what would today's prices cost for the basket people bought in the base period? Base-period quantities. Laspeyres.

The Paasche index uses current-period quantities. You ask: what would the basket people buy today have cost in the base period? Current-period quantities. Paasche.

That's the only difference. Base quantities, Laspeyres. Current quantities, Paasche. I want you to be able to say that in your sleep.

Now, there's a consequence, and this is the bit that separates a pass from a good mark. The Laspeyres index tends to overstate inflation, and the Paasche index tends to understate it. Why? Substitution. When the price of something rises, consumers buy less of it and switch to substitutes. Laspeyres holds the old quantities fixed, so it keeps pricing the expensive item at its old, higher quantity, and the index comes out too high. Paasche uses the new quantities, which already reflect the switch away from the expensive item, so it comes out too low. Substitution bias. Laspeyres up, Paasche down.

Because of that, the Fisher index exists. The Fisher ideal index is the geometric mean of the Laspeyres and the Paasche — you multiply them and take the square root. It sits between the two and corrects part of the substitution bias. It's called the ideal index because it satisfies the time reversal and factor reversal tests, which we won't do today, we'll do those next week, remind me.

Okay. Practical problem. In practice, statistical offices overwhelmingly use Laspeyres. Now why would they do that, if we've just said it's biased? Anyone? No? Data. It's a data problem. To compute Paasche you need current-period quantities, and quantity data comes from household expenditure surveys that take a year or more to collect and process. Prices you can collect weekly by sending someone into a shop. Base-period quantities you already have. So Laspeyres is the one you can actually publish monthly. Paasche is theoretically nicer and practically late.

Right, chain indices, briefly. When you compare periods far apart, a fixed base gets stale — the basket from 2005 is not the basket of today, nobody's buying DVD players. A chain index links successive period-to-period indices together by multiplying them, so the weights get refreshed each period. That keeps the basket current. The cost is that chain indices can drift when the series oscillates, and they lose direct comparability with the original base.

A couple of applications and then I'll let you go. Deflating a nominal series: you divide the nominal value by the price index and multiply by one hundred to get the real value. Real equals nominal divided by index, times one hundred. That's how you strip out price changes and get volume changes. Nominal GDP divided by the GDP deflator gives real GDP.

And one term you'll see in the reading: the GDP deflator is a Paasche-type index, because it uses current-period quantities — current output. The CPI is a Laspeyres-type index. That contrast comes up constantly and it's worth knowing.

One more thing on terminology, people confuse these. A price index measures price change holding quantities fixed. A quantity index, sometimes called a volume index, measures quantity change holding prices fixed. Same machinery, you just swap which variable moves.

Okay. Read chapter four, sections one to three, not section four, section four is on the seasonal adjustment which we do later. And check the portal for the deadline. See you Thursday.

Okay, morning everyone. Coffee's kicked in? Good. Quick housekeeping — the practical on Friday is in lab B, not lab A, they've moved us because of the refurbishment. Lab B. Write it down. And someone left a coat in here last week, it's at reception.

So. Synaptic transmission. This is the one you have to actually understand rather than memorise, because half the pharmacology in second year hangs off it.

A synapse is the junction where one neuron communicates with another cell. The neuron sending the signal is the presynaptic neuron, the one receiving it is the postsynaptic neuron, and the gap between them is the synaptic cleft, which is about twenty nanometres across.

Now, there are two kinds of synapse, and I'll be brief about the first because it barely comes up. Electrical synapses connect cells directly through gap junctions. Current flows straight from one cell to the next, it's essentially instantaneous, and it can go both directions. They're fast and they're rare in the mammalian brain. Chemical synapses are the ones that matter. They use a neurotransmitter, they're slower, there's a delay of roughly half a millisecond to a millisecond, and crucially they only go one way — presynaptic to postsynaptic. One direction. That unidirectionality is the whole reason circuits can compute anything.

Right, the sequence. Learn the sequence. I will ask you the sequence.

An action potential arrives at the axon terminal. The depolarisation opens voltage-gated calcium channels in the presynaptic membrane. Calcium rushes in, because the concentration outside the cell is far higher than inside. That calcium influx is the trigger — this is the step that converts an electrical signal into a chemical one. The calcium causes synaptic vesicles, which are little membrane sacs already loaded with neurotransmitter, to fuse with the presynaptic membrane and release their contents into the cleft. That's exocytosis. The neurotransmitter diffuses across the cleft and binds to receptors on the postsynaptic membrane. The receptor does something — depends on the receptor — and you get a postsynaptic potential.

I want to stress the calcium step. If you remove extracellular calcium, the action potential still arrives, the vesicles are still there, and nothing is released. Nothing. Calcium is the trigger, not the messenger.

Now, receptors. Two families, and this distinction is worth real marks.

Ionotropic receptors are ligand-gated ion channels. The receptor is the channel. Neurotransmitter binds, the pore opens, ions flow. It's fast — milliseconds — and the effect is short-lived. The nicotinic acetylcholine receptor is the classic example.

Metabotropic receptors are not channels. They're G-protein-coupled receptors. Binding activates a G protein, which activates a second messenger cascade, which then does something — maybe opens a channel elsewhere, maybe changes gene expression. Slower, hundreds of milliseconds to seconds, but longer-lasting and amplifying, because one receptor can activate many G proteins and each cascade produces many second messenger molecules. The muscarinic acetylcholine receptor is metabotropic. Same transmitter, acetylcholine, two completely different receptor families. That's the point — the effect of a neurotransmitter is determined by its receptor, not by the transmitter itself.

This is worth repeating because students get it backwards constantly. There is no such thing as an excitatory neurotransmitter. There are excitatory receptors. Acetylcholine excites skeletal muscle and slows the heart, same molecule, different receptors.

Postsynaptic potentials. An excitatory postsynaptic potential, EPSP, is a depolarisation that brings the membrane closer to threshold — typically sodium flowing in. An inhibitory postsynaptic potential, IPSP, is a hyperpolarisation moving it away from threshold — typically chloride in or potassium out. Neither one on its own fires an action potential. They're graded, they decay with distance and time, and they sum.

Summation, two kinds. Temporal summation is one input firing repeatedly in quick succession, so the potentials overlap before the previous one decays. Spatial summation is several different inputs firing at once at different locations. Both push toward threshold, and the decision point is the axon hillock, where the density of voltage-gated sodium channels is highest. That's where it's decided whether an action potential fires.

Then you have to clear the transmitter, otherwise the signal never stops. Three mechanisms. Reuptake, where transporters pull the transmitter back into the presynaptic terminal or into glia — that's how serotonin is cleared, and it's what SSRIs block. Enzymatic degradation, where an enzyme in the cleft breaks it down — acetylcholinesterase hydrolyses acetylcholine, and that's the target of nerve agents and of the drugs used in myasthenia gravis. And simple diffusion away from the cleft, which happens for everything but is only the main route for a few.

One more thing and then we'll stop. Synapses are not fixed. Repeated strong stimulation can produce long-term potentiation, a lasting increase in synaptic strength, and the opposite, long-term depression, a lasting decrease. That plasticity is the cellular basis of learning and memory, and it's chapter fourteen, which we do after Easter.

Okay. Read the sequence again tonight. Lab B on Friday. Go.

POGLAVJE 3 — RAČUNALNIŠKA OMREŽJA

Cilji poglavja
Po koncu tega poglavja bo študent razumel osnove računalniških omrežij, znal opisati plasti modela OSI in poznal razliko med naslovi. Študent bo tudi znal uporabiti pridobljeno znanje pri reševanju nalog.

Slika 3.1: Shematski prikaz omrežja. Na sliki vidimo več naprav, ki so povezane med seboj.

3.1 Uvod
Računalniško omrežje je skupina naprav, ki so povezane tako, da si lahko izmenjujejo podatke in delijo vire. Omrežja delimo glede na obseg. LAN (Local Area Network) pokriva majhno geografsko območje, na primer eno stavbo ali pisarno. WAN (Wide Area Network) povezuje oddaljena območja, na primer mesta ali države. Med njima je MAN (Metropolitan Area Network), ki pokriva območje mesta.

3.2 Referenčni model OSI
Model OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) je referenčni model, ki komunikacijo v omrežju razdeli na sedem plasti. Vsaka plast opravlja svojo nalogo in nudi storitve plasti nad seboj.

Sedem plasti od spodaj navzgor je: fizična plast, povezavna plast, omrežna plast, transportna plast, sejna plast, predstavitvena plast in aplikacijska plast.

Fizična plast (1) prenaša surove bite po fizičnem mediju. Določa napetostne nivoje, hitrost prenosa in vrsto konektorja.

Povezavna plast (2) skrbi za prenos okvirjev med sosednjima napravama v istem omrežnem segmentu in za zaznavanje napak. Na tej plasti se uporablja naslov MAC.

Omrežna plast (3) skrbi za usmerjanje paketov med različnimi omrežji. Na tej plasti deluje protokol IP in se uporablja naslov IP.

Transportna plast (4) zagotavlja prenos med končnima točkama. Tu delujeta protokola TCP in UDP.

Sejna plast (5) vzpostavlja, upravlja in zaključuje seje med aplikacijama.

Predstavitvena plast (6) skrbi za obliko zapisa podatkov, kodiranje in šifriranje.

Aplikacijska plast (7) je najbližje uporabniku in nudi storitve aplikacijam, na primer HTTP, FTP in SMTP.

Slika 3.2: Prikaz sedmih plasti modela OSI. Plasti so prikazane ena nad drugo.

3.3 Naslavljanje
Naslov MAC je fizični naslov omrežne kartice. Je 48-bitni naslov, zapisan šestnajstiško, in ga proizvajalec zapiše v napravo. Naslov MAC se ne spreminja glede na omrežje, v katerega je naprava priključena.

Naslov IP je logični naslov. Naslov IPv4 je 32-biten, naslov IPv6 pa 128-biten. Naslov IP se spremeni, ko napravo priključimo v drugo omrežje.

Ključna razlika: naslov MAC identificira napravo znotraj lokalnega segmenta, naslov IP pa identificira napravo v širšem omrežju in omogoča usmerjanje.

Protokol ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) prevede naslov IP v naslov MAC znotraj lokalnega omrežja.

Protokol DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) samodejno dodeli napravi naslov IP, masko podomrežja in privzeti prehod.

Sistem DNS (Domain Name System) prevede domensko ime v naslov IP.

3.4 Omrežne naprave
Stikalo (switch) deluje na povezavni plasti in posreduje okvirje na podlagi naslova MAC. Zapomni si, na katerih vratih je katera naprava.

Usmerjevalnik (router) deluje na omrežni plasti in posreduje pakete med različnimi omrežji na podlagi naslova IP.

Razdelilnik (hub) je starejša naprava na fizični plasti, ki prejeti signal pošlje na vsa vrata brez presoje.

3.5 Protokola TCP in UDP
TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) je povezavno usmerjen protokol. Pred prenosom vzpostavi povezavo s postopkom trosmernega rokovanja, zagotavlja zanesljivost, pravilen vrstni red paketov in ponovno pošiljanje izgubljenih paketov. Uporablja se tam, kjer je pomembna zanesljivost, na primer pri spletnem brskanju in prenosu datotek.

UDP (User Datagram Protocol) je nepovezaven protokol. Povezave ne vzpostavlja, ne zagotavlja vrstnega reda in ne pošilja izgubljenih paketov ponovno. Je hitrejši in ima manjšo režijo. Uporablja se pri pretakanju videa, spletni telefoniji in igrah v realnem času.

Glavni kompromis: TCP zagotavlja zanesljivost na račun hitrosti, UDP pa hitrost na račun zanesljivosti.

Slika 3.3: Primerjava TCP in UDP.

Povzetek poglavja
V tem poglavju smo spoznali osnove računalniških omrežij, model OSI in naslavljanje. Snov je pomembna za razumevanje nadaljnjih poglavij. Priporočamo, da rešite vaje na koncu poglavja.

Vprašanja za ponovitev so na voljo v spletni učilnici.

OBLIGACIJSKO PRAVO — 2. DEL

Učni cilji
Po predelanem poglavju bo študent razumel nastanek obligacijskega razmerja, znal razlikovati med vrstami pogodb in poznal pogoje odškodninske odgovornosti. Študent bo znal svoje znanje uporabiti pri reševanju praktičnih primerov.

1. Obligacijsko razmerje
Obligacijsko razmerje je pravno razmerje med dvema strankama, v katerem je ena stranka (upnik) upravičena od druge stranke (dolžnika) zahtevati določeno izpolnitev, dolžnik pa je to izpolnitev dolžan opraviti. Predmet obligacije je lahko dajatev, storitev, opustitev ali dopustitev.

Obligacijsko razmerje je relativno pravno razmerje, kar pomeni, da učinkuje samo med strankama in ne proti vsem. V tem se razlikuje od stvarnopravnih razmerij, ki so absolutna in učinkujejo proti vsakomur.

Obligacijska razmerja nastanejo iz štirih temeljnih virov: iz pogodbe, iz povzročitve škode, iz neupravičene obogatitve in iz poslovodstva brez naročila.

2. Pogodba
Pogodba je dvostranski pravni posel, ki nastane s soglasjem volj dveh ali več strank. Za sklenitev pogodbe sta potrebni ponudba in sprejem ponudbe.

Ponudba je predlog za sklenitev pogodbe, ki mora vsebovati vse bistvene sestavine pogodbe in izražati voljo ponudnika, da bo ob sprejemu vezan. Ponudba, ki ne vsebuje bistvenih sestavin, ni ponudba, temveč zgolj vabilo k ponudbi. Razstavljeno blago z označeno ceno se šteje za ponudbo, katalog ali oglas pa praviloma za vabilo k ponudbi.

Sprejem je izjava volje naslovnika, da ponudbo sprejema. Sprejem mora biti brezpogojen. Sprejem s spremembami se ne šteje za sprejem, temveč za novo ponudbo (protiponudbo), s čimer prvotna ponudba ugasne. Molk naslovnika praviloma ne pomeni sprejema.

Pogodba je sklenjena v trenutku, ko ponudnik prejme izjavo o sprejemu. To imenujemo teorija prejema.

3. Pogoji za veljavnost pogodbe
Za veljavnost pogodbe morajo biti izpolnjeni štirje pogoji: poslovna sposobnost strank, soglasje volj brez napak, dopustna in določna vsebina ter dopustna podlaga. Kadar zakon zahteva posebno obliko, je oblika peti pogoj.

Poslovno sposobnost pridobi fizična oseba praviloma s polnoletnostjo, torej z dopolnjenim 18. letom starosti. Mladoletnik od 15. leta lahko sklepa posle manjšega pomena.

Napake volje so zmota, prevara in grožnja. Bistvena zmota je zmota o bistveni lastnosti predmeta ali o osebi, kadar je bila pogodba sklenjena prav zaradi te osebe. Prevara pomeni, da je ena stranka pri drugi namerno povzročila zmoto ali jo v zmoti pustila. Grožnja pomeni, da je stranka sklenila pogodbo zaradi utemeljenega strahu pred neposredno nevarnostjo.

Pogodba, sklenjena zaradi napake volje, je izpodbojna. To je pomembna razlika: nična pogodba ne učinkuje od začetka in se na ničnost lahko sklicuje vsakdo, izpodbojna pogodba pa učinkuje, dokler je upravičena stranka ne izpodbija. Rok za izpodbijanje je eno leto od dneva, ko je stranka izvedela za razlog, in največ tri leta od sklenitve pogodbe.

Nična je pogodba, ki nasprotuje ustavi, prisilnim predpisom ali morali. Ničnost učinkuje po samem zakonu in ne zastara.

4. Oblika pogodbe
V našem pravu velja načelo neformalnosti: pogodba je praviloma veljavna ne glede na obliko. Zakon pa za nekatere pogodbe predpisuje obliko. Pogodba o prenosu nepremičnine mora biti sklenjena v pisni obliki, podpis prodajalca pa mora biti notarsko overjen. Pogodba, ki ni sklenjena v predpisani obliki, je nična, razen če sta stranki pogodbo v pretežnem delu izpolnili.

Slika 4.1: Shema sklenitve pogodbe. Na sliki so prikazani koraki od ponudbe do sklenitve.

5. Izpolnitev in kršitev
Obveznost preneha predvsem z izpolnitvijo. Izpolnitev mora biti pravilna po vsebini, kraju, času in osebi. Poleg izpolnitve obveznost preneha tudi s pobotom, odpustom dolga, novacijo, združitvijo in zastaranjem.

Dolžnik pride v zamudo, ko obveznosti ne izpolni v roku. Če rok ni določen, pride v zamudo, ko ga upnik pozove k izpolnitvi. Posledica zamude so zamudne obresti, ki tečejo od dneva zamude in jih upnik lahko zahteva, ne da bi dokazoval škodo.

Pri dvostranskih pogodbah lahko stranka, ki je svojo obveznost izpolnila, ob kršitvi druge stranke odstopi od pogodbe. Če je rok bistvena sestavina pogodbe, pogodba ob zamudi razpade po samem zakonu. Če rok ni bistvena sestavina, mora upnik dolžniku pustiti dodatni primerni rok in šele nato lahko odstopi.

6. Odškodninska odgovornost
Za nastanek odškodninske odgovornosti morajo biti kumulativno izpolnjene štiri predpostavke: protipravno ravnanje, škoda, vzročna zveza med ravnanjem in škodo ter odgovornost povzročitelja. Če manjka le ena predpostavka, odgovornosti ni.

Škoda se deli na premoženjsko in nepremoženjsko. Premoženjska škoda obsega navadno škodo, torej zmanjšanje premoženja, in izgubljeni dobiček, torej preprečeno povečanje premoženja. Nepremoženjska škoda obsega telesne bolečine, duševne bolečine in strah.

Poznamo dve podlagi odgovornosti. Krivdna odgovornost temelji na krivdi povzročitelja, pri čemer se krivda domneva; oškodovanec torej krivde ni dolžan dokazovati, povzročitelj pa se lahko razbremeni, če dokaže, da je ravnal skrbno. Objektivna odgovornost je odgovornost ne glede na krivdo in velja za škodo od nevarne stvari ali nevarne dejavnosti. Imetnik nevarne stvari se razbremeni le, če dokaže višjo silo, ravnanje oškodovanca ali ravnanje tretje osebe.

Odškodnina se praviloma odmeri v denarju, sodišče pa lahko odloči tudi o vzpostavitvi prejšnjega stanja. Če je k nastanku škode prispeval tudi oškodovanec, se odškodnina sorazmerno zmanjša.

Odškodninski zahtevek zastara v treh letih od dneva, ko je oškodovanec izvedel za škodo in za povzročitelja, v vsakem primeru pa v petih letih od nastanka škode.

7. Zastaranje
Zastaranje pomeni, da upnik po poteku zakonskega roka izgubi pravico zahtevati izpolnitev po sodni poti, obveznost sama pa ne preneha. Splošni zastaralni rok je pet let. Terjatve iz gospodarskih pogodb zastarajo v treh letih. Občasne terjatve, na primer najemnina, zastarajo v treh letih. Sodišče na zastaranje ne pazi po uradni dolžnosti, dolžnik se mora nanj sklicevati.

Povzetek
V poglavju smo obravnavali nastanek obligacijskega razmerja, sklenitev in veljavnost pogodbe ter odškodninsko odgovornost. Snov je podlaga za naslednja poglavja. Rešite naloge na koncu poglavja in preverite odgovore v spletni učilnici.
